text: {"name":"hci_le_event_proc","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a Bluetooth LE event buffer and its controller state, clearing completed event flags, adjusting pending link/ACL counters, triggering RF or ACL transmission, and scheduling or reporting advertising/scan results.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"le_ctrl","v2":"evt","v3":"evt_flags","v4":"acl_ready_flag","v5":"evt_payload","v6":"evt_flags","v7":"pending_evts","v8":"next_tx_time","v9":"adv_scan_mode","v10":"time_delta","v11":"pending_evts"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":36,"meaning":"event buffer data/payload pointer"},{"offset":80,"meaning":"event scheduled TX timestamp/anchor"},{"offset":85,"meaning":"event status flags byte"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"advertising/scan mode"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"link or context index"},{"offset":222,"meaning":"LE timing interval"},{"offset":88,"meaning":"LE controller state byte; bit 0x40 enables RF TX after last pending event"},{"offset":90,"meaning":"active LE link count"},{"offset":91,"meaning":"pending LE event counter"}]}
